title: Start using the Infra Standard
body:
See https://blog.whatwg.org/infra for background. Let's use this issue to track the changes we'll want to make to HTML. I anticipate us doing so over the course of several PRs, as the data structures especially might require some back and forth (e.g. adding missing things to Infra for manipulating them).

- Overall integration
  - [ ] Add to [the kitchen sink diagram](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/introduction.html#abstract), maybe? It's also missing Fetch, and is getting crowded.
  - [x] Add a prominent "HTML depends on the Infra Standard" somewhere early; maybe in the beginning of [2. Common infrastructure](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#infrastructure), before 2.1. Terminology?
  - [x] Add an appropriate section with dfn cross references to [Dependencies](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#dependencies); probably before anything else
- Removal of now-redundant things
  - [x] Remove byte sequences from [typographic conventions](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/introduction.html#typographic-conventions)
  - [x] Remove the definition of "or" from [Terminology](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#terminology)
  - [ ] Remove all of [case-sensitivity and string comparison](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#case-sensitivity-and-string-comparison). I guess we need to move "prefix match" into Infra.
  - [ ] Remove most of the character classes defined in [common parser idioms](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#common-parser-idioms)
  - [x] Remove [conformance requirements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#conformance-requirements). Maybe we want to move its example into Infra.
  - [x] Remove [Namespaces](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#namespaces) but move its user agent note somewhere else, probably (maybe the XML section)
- Data structure usage (not complete, update as we find more...)
  - [x] module map
  - [ ] CustomElementRegistry (kind of a strange case)
  - [ ] when-defined promise map
  - [ ] custom element reaction queue
  - [ ] custom element reactions stack
  - [ ] element queue
  - [ ] backup element queue
